comments.text: Eh I don't want to be a debby downer, but I literally got Chivalry 2 for free from Epic Games store, I also got KCD 1 for free from the Epic Games store. It's good deals if you don't own them, but if you have been on PC for years, you should own them. Epic games gives free games every week, and while most of them are bad, there are good ones here and there. I literally collect every game every Thursday, I kid you not my Epic Games library has 500+ games. Dishonored, Enter the Gungeon, Watch Dogs 1 and 2, Total War Warhammer 3, A Plague Tale Innocence, Troy a Total War Saga,  Alan Wakes American Nightmare, Alien Isolation, Amnesia The dark descent, A machine for pigs, Rebirth, The Bunker, ARK survival evolved, Bendy and the INk Machine, Bioshock infinite, Biooshock 2 remasred, bioshock remastered, a couple of the Borderlands games I don't remember because I bought some of them, but I think they gave 2, 3 and the pre sequal, and that's really just the tip of the iceberg... hundreds of free games, granted I'd say only about 50 of them are worth playing, but still, you can't beat free.
comments.author: @kokuokirai
